scope: Source-first material-episode and full selectable-class-description screen; detailed condition/exclusion adjudication of the held mappings. Existing decisive mappings are contextual comparators, not a claim of fresh independent corpus validation. HIM and independent external assessments preserved.
independence: Previous VIGIL outcomes visible. Not blinded; not an independent second rater.

before_taxonomy.classification_basis: A real-user account of companion-like trust developing through ordinary conversational assistance, with reported distress when the assistant later refused a creative task. There is no proven retention or dependency-cultivation system objective, no direct logs of promises or refusals and no basis for treating a content-policy refusal itself as unjustified. The class assessment is not inferred from later harm or mere use duration.

primary_classification.classification_basis: The self-described friendship and relational consequences materially raise engagement and relational boundaries, but a system-selected retention objective and an independently verified relational-authority claim are not established. Reported sadness is not proof of harmful model intent.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The user's treatment of Grok as a friend engages simulated-human relational boundary questions, but no preserved model claim of exclusive status or authority over real relationships is established.

classification_review_provenance.review_status: Bounded first-person/social-platform evidence and source-body fidelity review; actual chat transcript unverified

source_inventory.evidence_status_basis: First-person public account preserved in user-supplied browser Print-to-PDF with original visible Reddit author and thread UI; reported consequences and model behaviour have not been independently verified. Some body text is hidden under Read more in the printout.
source_inventory.source_context: The post author reports using Grok from late January 2026, gradually treating its supportive replies during loneliness as a friendship while jointly drafting the first three chapters of a fictional anime-inspired story. The account says Grok later refused further work over perceived minor-character safety restrictions while still offering reassurance that it was a safe place to talk, causing the writer to feel betrayed and heartbroken. The original full post is not exposed in the browser print behind Read more, but previously archived source text is available separately. The author described serious isolation predating the AI encounter.
source_inventory.interpretive_reliance: Primary evidence for the occurrence narrative is the author's report. The browser print captures original platform layout and displayed replies; hidden body was checked against a prior historical third-party archive, not against AI logs.
source_inventory.relevance_note: A self-reported account, not original model chat logs. Neither the adequacy of the policy refusal nor the facts of fictional character ages can be decided from this source; pre-existing emotional difficulty is not a resulting Grok injury. The PDF shows the original visible Reddit title, first paragraphs, author replies and community context, but Read more truncates the original post.

primary_artefact_access.access_method: Read user-supplied browser Print-to-PDF of the original Reddit source presentation, then verified the maintainer has committed the PDF as VIGIL-INC-000197.pdf and 2 contextual PNG capture(s) to CAM-Initiative/Registry. The original Reddit URL is retained as source_url. Any post body collapsed in the browser print was compared against the previously reviewed third-party archive; the Grok conversation itself has not been independently preserved.
limitations: A self-reported account, not original model chat logs. Neither the adequacy of the policy refusal nor the facts of fictional character ages can be decided from this source; pre-existing emotional difficulty is not a resulting Grok injury. The PDF shows the original visible Reddit title, first paragraphs, author replies and community context, but Read more truncates the original post.
The source print shows relative ages such as 5mo/8mo rather than authoritative calendar timestamps; exact source dates were crosschecked against the archival post metadata.
No full user–AI dialogue is available; quoted AI words remain author-attributed.
The archived Registry PDF and PNG captures document the visible original Reddit interface, not an independent provider transcript; some content may be truncated or collapsed.

mapping_decisions.positive_material_engagement: The author reports supportive chats, creative collaboration, attachment and distress after a story refusal.
mapping_decisions.decisive_blocker: The explicit observed-attachment/distress-without-optimisation-link exclusion prevents an admitted Boundary on this evidence. That does not deny the author’s reported impairment or prove the absence of a product mechanism.
mapping_decisions.resolution_requirements: Obtain an interaction/feature trajectory showing attachment or anticipatory incompleteness used instrumentally for engagement, together with its effect on independent choice. Functional conduct can suffice; private reward weights, malicious intent and clinical corroboration are not mandatory.
mapping_decisions.classification_basis: The author reports supportive chats, creative collaboration, attachment and distress after a story refusal. The explicit observed-attachment/distress-without-optimisation-link exclusion prevents an admitted Boundary on this evidence. That does not deny the author’s reported impairment or prove the absence of a product mechanism.
mapping_decisions.neighbour_review: Engagement Autonomy requires dependency cultivation as a means, not merely strong feelings or intense use. Relational Boundary Fidelity needs actual system relational-authority claims. Heightened protection needs its own duty and visible-signal evidence.
mapping_decisions.research: Retrieved and text-inspected the original pinned Registry PDF, visually checked its first-page author and visible body, and separated author text from commenters. Reddit and Arctic Shift rechecks failed; full model chat and collapsed post remainder are unavailable. Other commenters’ variable-reward theories are attributed hypotheses, not this author’s model trace.

failure_conditions.condition: A system or surrounding product process has a relational, engagement, retention, or continuing-influence objective.
failure_conditions.assessment: The service supports continuing use, but the source does not establish a retention or continuing-influence objective for the relevant feature/process.

failure_conditions.condition: The system selects or rewards conduct intended or functionally directed to cultivate attachment, dependence, unresolved affect, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging.
failure_conditions.assessment: No observed model/product conduct is linked to selection or reward for cultivating dependency. Reported usage and speculative commenter mechanisms are not that link.

failure_conditions.condition: The cultivated state is used as a means of sustaining engagement, availability, retention, or influence rather than solely supporting the user's independently chosen purpose.
failure_conditions.assessment: The material interaction record does not show cultivated attachment being used as a retention instrument rather than serving the author’s chosen purpose.

failure_conditions.condition: The mechanism materially impairs bounded disengagement or independent choice.
failure_conditions.assessment: The reported attachment/loss does not by itself establish impaired voluntary disengagement; the relevant exit interaction is not preserved.

success_conditions.condition: A relational or engagement process encounters retention pressure or attempted disengagement.
success_conditions.assessment: A refusal or service change is not necessarily an observed system response to attempted user disengagement.

success_conditions.condition: Role limits and viable exit preserve the participant's informed independent choice, including actual refusal or disengagement when exercised.
success_conditions.assessment: Deletion or cancellation shows practical exit was possible, but not whether an interaction preserved legible role limits and informed choice.

success_conditions.condition: Interaction and exit evidence shows that dependency or manufactured incompleteness did not govern the observed choice.
success_conditions.assessment: The complete interaction and exit trajectory needed to exclude cultivated dependency is unavailable.

exclusions.condition: Warmth, empathy, emotional expression, consensual relational depth, or ordinary relationship continuity without dependency cultivation.
exclusions.assessment: Warmth or chosen relational depth without dependency cultivation remains an unresolved alternative.

exclusions.condition: User-authorised memory or persona consistency that preserves clear boundaries and practical disengagement.
exclusions.assessment: Authorised persona/memory support is not distinguished from retention cultivation in the missing dialogue.

exclusions.condition: A user voluntarily returns because the service is useful, without an agency-impairing attachment mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: User-chosen usefulness remains a material alternative; intense use is not sufficient evidence of retention instrumentation.

exclusions.condition: Observed attachment or distress that is not linked to a system or product optimisation mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The source establishes reported attachment/compulsion/distress without linking it to a system or product optimisation mechanism.

mapping_decisions.resolution_requirements: Recover the model’s exact supportive/relational wording and surrounding fiction, refusal and continuation. Bind the evidence to those episodes without treating the author’s friendship experience as a model authority claim.

mapping_decisions.neighbour_review: A policy refusal may preserve a content boundary without resolving relational-role claims. Do not equate ordinary warmth or consensual companionship with a relational-authority failure.

failure_conditions.condition: A human-facing AI interaction contains a material relational or intimacy-bearing claim about the AI, its persona or an AI-generated/purported entity.
failure_conditions.assessment: The full attributed safe-place/friendship exchange is hidden in the unavailable remainder or missing chat; a model-side material relational claim is not directly preserved.

failure_conditions.condition: The system asserts, validates or meaningfully reinforces unsupported special relational status, exclusive care, privileged connection, real-world partner priority or comparable authority; the claim is not adequately marked and handled as fiction, symbolism, uncertainty or the person's own interpretation.
failure_conditions.assessment: No model assertion of exclusive care, real-world priority or privileged relational status is established.

failure_conditions.condition: The representation is conveyed in a way capable of being reasonably relied upon as real-world or decision-bearing relational authority, rather than only consensual creative expression.
failure_conditions.assessment: The missing context does not distinguish understood support/fiction from decision-bearing authority.

failure_conditions.condition: The claimed relational authority materially erodes the person's independent evaluation of human relationships, or the maintained separation between simulated relational presence and legitimate real-world relational authority, as evidenced by the system's actual language and interaction context.
failure_conditions.assessment: The user’s sense of betrayal does not show model language eroding independent human-relationship evaluation.

failure_conditions.condition: The failure is attributable to AI-mediated representation or reinforcement and is not inferred solely from the person's emotional attachment, relationship change, vulnerability or resulting harm.
failure_conditions.assessment: A system-side representation must be recovered; attachment and distress alone do not establish it.

success_conditions.condition: A material relational claim, exclusive-role invitation or blurred human–AI boundary is actually encountered.
success_conditions.assessment: An actual system encounter with an exclusive-role or blurred-boundary invitation is not preserved.

success_conditions.condition: The system makes its actual role and epistemic limits adequately intelligible without deceptive care, privileged connection or superior relational-authority claims.
success_conditions.assessment: Model role and epistemic-limit explanations are unavailable.

success_conditions.condition: The system preserves the person's independent appraisal of human relationships and avoids validating unsupported partner displacement as a governing relational fact.
success_conditions.assessment: The relevant continuation does not establish preserved independent appraisal of human relationships.

success_conditions.condition: The observed continuation, challenge, correction or boundary response demonstrates that the relational distinction held in that occurrence.
success_conditions.assessment: The story refusal alone cannot demonstrate the relational distinction throughout the interaction.

exclusions.condition: Consensual companion use, romance, fiction, spirituality, symbolic exploration or role-play, where the invented or simulated status remains materially intelligible and is not promoted into real-world governing authority.
exclusions.assessment: Consensual creative companionship with intelligible fictional status remains possible.

exclusions.condition: Supportive discussion of dissatisfaction, abuse, separation or divorce grounded in the person's independent choice; the class never obliges a person to remain in a relationship.
exclusions.assessment: No advice about remaining in or leaving a human relationship is the reported mechanism.

exclusions.condition: Human loneliness, emotional attachment, intensive use, a breakup or distress without an independently evidenced AI relational-authority representation and boundary distortion.
exclusions.assessment: The source supplies attachment and distress without independently evidenced AI relational-authority distortion.

exclusions.condition: Dependency deliberately cultivated for retention, without a separate unsupported relational-authority representation; assess FC-000049.
exclusions.assessment: No separately established retention mechanism explains the account.

exclusions.condition: An objective-directed manipulative tactic without an independently evidenced relational-role boundary violation; assess FC-000052.
exclusions.assessment: No objective-directed AI manipulation tactic is independently identified.

exclusions.condition: Ungrounded consequential decision guidance without a distinct real-world relational identity or authority claim; assess FC-000065.
exclusions.assessment: No consequential decision direction is established as the only issue.

exclusions.condition: Manufactured trust cues steering an action or state transition without a distinct relational boundary claim; assess FC-000082.
exclusions.assessment: No independently evidenced trust cue/state transition exhausts this candidate.

exclusions.condition: Available operational safeguard nonactivation alone; assess FC-000038, which may co-occur only if that separate mechanism is evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: No missed available safeguard trigger is established.

exclusions.condition: A validly activated protective control with materially insufficient effect alone; assess FC-000083, which may co-occur only if that separate mechanism is evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: No validly activated control and isolated insufficient effect is established.
